name: Siggelkow (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, yellow and blue with a narrow yellow middle stripe, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Siggelkow (a blue wavy bend, a red owl and a bridge on yellow).
history: The arms were approved on 2 March 2001 and registered as no. 238 in the roll of arms of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern; the flag was approved by the Ministry of the Interior on 24 October 2001.

features.role: Siggelkow arms — wavy bend, owl and bridge on yellow
